name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_summary: 100% free distribution and surgical fitting of modern assistive devices, motorized tricycles, braille kits, digital hearing aids, and cochlear implants.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances) guidelines.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
